Selective PDF controls and photographer presets
Homepage on-page SEO and social sharing

decisions: JPG, PNG, WebP, and PDF support in V1
One remover homepage only
Files are processed locally in the browser
Batch cleanup and ZIP download are part of V1
No ads in the initial release
Dark theme is the default with a persisted light-theme toggle
Technical file properties are shown separately from privacy metadata
Heavy metadata libraries load only when users need them
Custom PDF cleanup exposes every detected identity field selected by default
Photographer Mode removes location, identity, serial numbers, and exact dates while retaining safe camera settings where supported
Unsafe selective image preservation falls back to full metadata removal
Release verification covers Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and mobile viewports
The primary SEO keyword is the correctly spelled metadata remover; misspelled variants are excluded
The homepage uses the H1 Free Metadata Remover for Photos, Images and PDFs
Homepage copy totals approximately 800-1200 words while the remover stays first
Canonical production URL is https://metadataremovertool.com/
Homepage SEO includes Open Graph, Twitter Card, WebApplication, and visible FAQ metadata
Expanded FAQ answers stay concise and use the same source data as JSON-LD
Word-document FAQ entries transparently state that Word cleanup is unsupported in V1 and provide only general official guidance
Release changes remain uncommitted for user review

lastSession.note: Approved an expanded concise FAQ for metadata questions, including transparent Word-document guidance while keeping Word cleanup out of V1.
